name: ampliconsuite-dnanexus-applet
title: AmpliconSuite
summary: Applet to run PrepareAA, AmpliconArchitect, and AmpliconClassifier

inputSpec.name: bam
inputSpec.label: tumor WGS
inputSpec.help: Indexed bam file containing tumor WGS.

inputSpec.name: normal_bam
inputSpec.label: matched normal WGS
inputSpec.help: Optional indexed bam file containing matched-normal WGS. If given, CNVkit 0.9.6 builds its reference from this sample (paired mode); otherwise tumor-only.

inputSpec.name: normal_index
inputSpec.label: matched normal WGS index
inputSpec.help: Index for the matched-normal bam file. Required if normal_bam is given.

inputSpec.name: cngain
inputSpec.label: copy number threshold
inputSpec.help: Copy number threshold to search for amplifications. CN below this threshold will not be considered.

inputSpec.name: data_repo
inputSpec.label: AA data repo
inputSpec.help: The data_repo directory for AA. Must be writable.

inputSpec.name: mosek_lic
inputSpec.label: mosek license .lic
inputSpec.help: A mosek licence is required. A free license for academic use can be obtained at https://www.mosek.com/products/academic-licenses/

inputSpec.name: aa_version
inputSpec.label: tool versions
inputSpec.help: original: PrepareAA (Apr 2020, 8284de8), AmpliconArchitect 1.2, AmpliconClassifier 1.1.2, CNVkit 0.9.6. reanalysis: AmpliconSuite-pipeline 1.3.3, AmpliconArchitect 1.4.r2, AmpliconClassifier 1.2.0, CNVkit 0.9.6.

outputSpec.name: results
outputSpec.label: AmpliconSuite results
outputSpec.help: CNVkit, PrepareAA/AA and AC outputs for the sample.

outputSpec.name: tool_versions
outputSpec.label: tool versions
outputSpec.help: Tool versions, image and run parameters used for this run.
